intended_message: We understand your pitch about cutting QA time, but we disagree it's a problem for us and don't want to buy.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Hi Priya, thanks for jumping on — I wanted to show how our automation suite could cut your QA cycle in half.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Yeah I get it, Alex, and the demo makes sense — I just don't agree cycle time is an issue for us right now.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Okay, so is it more about coverage then? Because we help a lot there too.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: No, we're good on both, honestly. We're going to stick with what we have, but thanks for reaching out.
